cases.sentence: Для того, чтобы предпринять что-нибудь в семейной жизни, необходимы или совершенный ___ между супругами, или любовное согласие.
cases.translation: In order to undertake anything in family life, either complete discord between spouses or loving harmony is necessary.
cases.explain: Раздор is the subject complement of «необходимы» (are necessary), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Не имея еще ___ для ревности, она отыскивала его.
cases.translation: Not yet having an object for her jealousy, she went looking for one.
cases.explain: The verbal construction «не имея» (not having) governs the genitive case, giving предмета.

cases.sentence: Она ревновала его не к какой-нибудь женщине, а к ___ его любви.
cases.translation: She was not jealous of him over any particular woman, but over the diminishing of his love.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) governs the dative case, giving уменьшению (a decrease).

cases.sentence: Он должен был часть любви перенести на других или на другую ___.
cases.translation: He must have transferred part of his love to others, or to another woman.
cases.explain: The preposition на (onto) with a verb of transfer takes the accusative case, giving женщину.

cases.sentence: И опять он же был виноват в том, что она навеки разлучена с ___.
cases.translation: And again he was to blame for the fact that she was separated from her son forever.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) after «разлучена» (separated) governs the instrumental case, giving сыном.

cases.sentence: В том, что она жила в Москве, а не в ___, он же был виноват.
cases.translation: He was to blame for the fact that she lived in Moscow and not in the countryside.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) denoting location governs the prepositional case, giving деревне.

reading.ru: Для того, чтобы предпринять что-нибудь в семейной жизни, необходимы или совершенный раздор между супругами, или любовное согласие.
reading.question: What does the narrator say is necessary in order to undertake anything in family life?
options: Either complete discord or loving harmony between spouses
reading.correct: Either complete discord or loving harmony between spouses
reading.explain: The text states that either complete discord or loving harmony between spouses is necessary before anything can be done.

reading.ru: Когда же отношения супругов неопределённы и нет ни того, ни другого, никакое дело не может быть предпринято.
reading.question: What happens when the relations between spouses are undefined, with neither discord nor harmony?
reading.explain: The text says that when relations are undefined, no matter can be undertaken.

reading.ru: Евронскому и Анне московская жизнь в жару и пыли, когда солнце светило уже не по весеннему, а по летнему, и все деревья на бульварах уже давно были в листьях, и листья уже были покрыты пылью, была невыносима.
reading.question: How did Vronsky and Anna feel about Moscow life in the heat and dust?
reading.explain: The text says Moscow life in the heat and dust was unbearable (невыносима) for them.

reading.ru: Для нее весь он со всеми его привычками, мыслями, желаниями, со всем его душевным и физическим складом был одно – любовь к женщинам.
reading.question: According to Anna's feeling, what did Vronsky's whole being come down to?
reading.explain: The text says that for her, everything about him was one thing: love of women.

reading.ru: Она ревновала его не к какой-нибудь женщине, а к уменьшению его любви.
reading.question: What was Anna truly jealous of, rather than any particular woman?
reading.explain: The text says she was jealous not of any particular woman, but of the diminishing of his love.

reading.ru: И ревнуя его, Анна негодовала на него и отыскивала во всем поводы к негодованию.
reading.question: While being jealous of him, what did Anna do?
options: Looked for reasons to be indignant with him
reading.correct: Looked for reasons to be indignant with him
reading.explain: The text says that, being jealous, Anna resented him and sought out grounds for resentment in everything.

reading.ru: В том, что она жила в Москве, а не в деревне, он же был виноват.
reading.question: Whom did Anna blame for the fact that she lived in Moscow rather than the countryside?
reading.explain: The text says that he (Vronsky) was to blame for her living in Moscow instead of the countryside.

reading.ru: И опять он же был виноват в том, что она навеки разлучена с сыном.
reading.question: What else did Anna blame Vronsky for?
options: Being separated forever from her son
reading.correct: Being separated forever from her son
reading.explain: The text says he was again to blame for her being separated forever from her son.

reading.ru: Анна одна, ожидая его возвращения с холостого обеда, на который он поехал, ходила взад и вперед по его кабинету, комната, где менее был слышен шум мостовой, и во всех подробностях передумывала выражение вчерашней ссоры.
reading.question: What was Anna doing while waiting for Vronsky to return from a bachelor dinner?
options: Pacing his study, replaying yesterday's quarrel
reading.correct: Pacing his study, replaying yesterday's quarrel
reading.explain: The text says Anna paced back and forth in his study, going over every detail of yesterday's quarrel.

reading.ru: Все началось с того, что он посмеялся над женскими гимназиями, считая их ненужными, а она заступилась за них.
reading.question: What subject sparked the original quarrel between Anna and Vronsky?
reading.explain: The text says it all began when he laughed at women's gymnasiums, calling them unnecessary, and she defended them.

reading.ru: Она видела в этом презрительный намек на свои занятия.
reading.question: How did Anna interpret Vronsky's remark that the English girl did not need physics?
options: As a contemptuous hint about her own pursuits
reading.correct: As a contemptuous hint about her own pursuits
reading.explain: The text says Anna saw in this a contemptuous hint at her own occupations.

reading.ru: «Очень жалею, что одно грубое и материальное вам понятно и натурально», — сказала она и вышла из комнаты.
reading.question: What did Anna say just before leaving the room during the quarrel?
options: That only the crude and material was clear and natural to him
That she was leaving him forever
reading.correct: That only the crude and material was clear and natural to him
reading.explain: Anna said she was very sorry that only the crude and material was comprehensible and natural to him, then left the room.

reading.ru: Он хотел сказать «ненатурально», не любя свою дочь, любить чужого ребенка.
reading.question: What did Anna imagine Vronsky meant by calling her attachment to the girl "unnatural"?
options: Loving someone else's child while not loving his own daughter
reading.correct: Loving someone else's child while not loving his own daughter
reading.explain: Anna imagines he meant it was unnatural to love someone else's child while not loving his own daughter.

reading.ru: И чтобы не думать более и не поддаваться раздражению, она позвонила и велела внести сундуки для укладки вещей в деревню.
reading.question: What did Anna do to stop dwelling on her irritation?
options: Rang the bell and ordered the trunks brought in for packing
reading.correct: Rang the bell and ordered the trunks brought in for packing
reading.explain: The text says she rang the bell and ordered the trunks brought in for packing, so as not to keep thinking and giving in to irritation.

reading.question: At what time did Vronsky arrive at the end of the chapter?
reading.explain: The final sentence states that Vronsky arrived at ten o'clock.
